lines.text: Ana needs a small gift for her hiking friend, something that fits a stocking.
She prints one sheet of paper.
Three folds, one cut, no glue, and it becomes an eight-page trail log that slips into a shirt pocket.
Five hikes, a line for the weather, the view and the snack verdict.
On the back page she writes a promise: a hike together.
Her friend fills it by March.
Save this for your gift list.
